publicApi.idempotency: Canonical body operationId must equal sole Idempotency-Key. New actions require FEE_SUBMIT/FEE_REVIEW/FEE_FINANCE with current CSRF; known original UUID POST recovery requires FEE_RECOVER (fees.read + actual CSRF) and current object-read scope; never re-executes the historical action.
publicApi.types: All IDs, monetary cents and versions are strings; UUID canonical lowercase. Status/decision uppercase. Boolean fields JSON booleans.
publicApi.history: Write/original-operation responses are immutable historical receipts; actions=[]; do not merge old version/state into a newer current detail. Detail/list are re-authorized current projections.
publicApi.list: ticketId required; page default1 max100000; size=20|50|100; duplicate/unknown query keys rejected; {items,page,size,hasMore}, current object scope rechecked on each item

quoteContext.canSubmit: Current qualified assigned engineer + current original quote/round + completed durable owner ACKs + no application yet for this quote. Paid unconfirmed quote may submit as WAITING_CUSTOMER. POST always rechecks; GET creates no application or operation.

authorities.identity: Online FEE_READ/SUBMIT/REVIEW/FINANCE/RECOVER purposes, current employee+enabled department+company scope+explicit capability; exact fee-recipients tenantId/companyId/departmentId/applicantUserId lists exclude applicant
authorities.finance: approval-finance POST /internal/finance/fee-approval-context exact sessionToken/groupId/quoteId/ticketId; original immutable quote basis, separate basisGroupVersion/currentGroupVersion, original source binding, exact confirmation and original lines
authorities.ticket: approval-ticket POST /internal/ticket/fee-approval-context same exact4 keys; currentActorUserId is caller, actorUserId/sourceActorUserId are source actor, original14 wire must match local committed owner fence
authorities.local: Frozen ruleVersion/threshold must match original approval_fee_rule_publication; no latest rule or default T substitution. Generation row current, OPEN and immutable full14 fence/COMMITTED terminal/result bindings checked under same local lock.

networkLockBoundary: All F/W/I network calls and original W proof reads before local transaction locks; freshness bounded by 2s and request deadline; transaction rechecks cached freshness and immutable local binding/generation. Stale proofs fail closed, no remote network under P business lock.
routing: B=max(Q,C,H), frozen financialReviewRequired=(everFinance || B>T); paid unconfirmed WAITING_CUSTOMER has no internal decision; independent current supervisor first then finance if frozen branch required. Missing eligible node -> WAITING_CONFIGURATION. Reject requires reason, withdraw only current authorized applicant, terminal history immutable.
assignment: Current assignmentId/departmentId/engineerUserId/currentRoundId must equal original persisted submission binding for a new existing-application mutation. Old original results may still be read with current object-read scope; no old callback restores assignment or permissions.

group.itemCheckedAt: Only top-level checkedAt for group. Individual facts are exact immutable stored completion payloads, same as query excluding checkedAt.

completionProtocol.actorUserId: Real final completing approver; finance node if required, otherwise supervisor. Never source actor or old session guess.
completionProtocol.decisionReceiptIds: Original immutable decision operation UUIDs. Finance receipt null if no finance branch required.
completionProtocol.coverageDigest: SHA256 lowercase hex: original lines sorted by id UUID lexical order; each exact5 string keys id,ticketId,roundId,amountCents,kind in TreeMap; compact Chain.JSON UTF8. Duplicate IDs/unknown kind/extra keys rejected.
completionProtocol.delivery: P exposes immutable service facts only; W owns reliable group pull and F mirror/H coordination. No P push into F, no fake delivered marker.

termination.scope: Verified W full14 binding, same tenant/ticket/company/group, original generation < new fenced generation, nonterminal applications only
termination.transaction: Persist new P generation fence FIRST; under same generation lock append exact termination receipt plus operation/audit/outbox, then compute final owner ACK snapshot. Any failure rolls all back.
termination.history: Original fee application snapshot/state and original operations unchanged; detail/list derive TERMINATED and resultingVersion from append-only termination receipt. No applicant-withdraw fabrication, no client basis generation rewrite.
termination.completed: COMPLETED and its completion fact unchanged; old completion is historical fact, not permission for new-generation execution.

transaction: Same physical transaction: generation lock -> application -> operation -> state/receipt/audit/outbox plus immutable binding/decision/completion. Known original replay only returns historical receipt after current read authorization. SQL/runtime rollback failure ->503 OPERATION_RESULT_UNKNOWN; no autoCommit restoration and uncertain connection discarded.

minimumRuntimeGrants.appendOnly: SELECT,INSERT only; no UPDATE or DELETE
minimumRuntimeGrants.existing: Existing generation mutation columns and immutable fence/ACK/terminal SELECT; approval_fee_rule_publication SELECT only

remainingAcceptance: Explicit V8/V9 fresh/default MySQL migration and actual minimum grants before new JAR
Real default trusted TLS/current identity+CSRF/fee branch and original result tests

Frontend real page integration and independent QA
Fee outbox notification production delivery not yet connected; local outbox persistence alone is not delivered
Completed approval cancellation requires a separate future immutable cancellation/execution-release fact; no terminal rewrite
scopeExclusions: Actual cash or refund evidence owned by finance
Paid PART execution mapping requires separate exact part/quantity/application coverage authority; generic PART fee amount never grants stock permission
